model.revision_scope: Public configuration pin selected for this new benchmark; historical serving checkpoint revision was not recovered.

workload.ep_scope: Not recorded; this dense local projection does not depend on expert parallelism.
workload.scheduler_policy: Declared fixed-batch scenario: one full 8192-token prefill per request, then 1024 full batches of 64 one-token decode calls. No speculative decoding in this scenario.

recorded_settings_source.description: Recorded GLM5.3-Flash workload settings; old saved kernel programs, fixtures, case lists and timings are not imported.
recorded_settings_source.historical_runtime: SGLang 0.5.20 with 18 overlays; equivalence to the new AITER runtime is unverified.

operator.boundary: Public gemm_a8w8_blockscale_bpreshuffle on already quantized activation and load-time preshuffled weight; activation quantization and row-parallel all-reduce are outside.
operator.shape_derivation: N=hidden_size=4096; K=intermediate_size/TP=12288/8=1536. The site is absent from modules_to_not_convert in the pinned FP8 configuration.

input_policy.x_and_canonical_weight: Uniform[-2,2] converted to E4M3FN, independently drawn
input_policy.x_scale: FP32 powers of two with integer exponents [-4,0], column-major [M,K/128]
input_policy.weight_scale: FP32 powers of two with integer exponents [-7,-2], row-major [N/128,K/128]
input_policy.origin: Parameterization of upstream test_gemm_a8w8_blockscale operand roles; exact distributions are task assumptions, not captured checkpoint values.
